description: Scala source code for the PipelineEventSender class, which manages sending pipeline events asynchronously to clients in Apache Spark's SQL connect pipelines module.

classes.name: PipelineEventSender
classes.description: Manages asynchronous sending of pipeline events to clients, with thread management and shutdown capabilities.

methods.name: sendEvent
methods.description: Queues an event for asynchronous sending if the sender is active; throws if shutdown.

methods.name: shouldEnqueueEvent
methods.description: Determines if an event should be enqueued based on its type and queue capacity.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Shuts down the sender, releasing resources.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Performs a graceful shutdown of the executor, waiting for ongoing tasks to complete.

methods.name: sendEventToClient
methods.description: Constructs and sends a pipeline event to the client via gRPC.

methods.name: constructProtoEvent
methods.description: Converts a PipelineEvent into its protobuf representation with timestamp and message.
